name: cppco.org.kh
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1 session cookie is readable by scripts.
lesson: Set Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite on every cookie that scripts do not need to read.
summary: cppco.org.kh scores 65 out of 100 (D). 3 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 3 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /login, /password/reset. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without HttpOnly: XSRF-TOKEN. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /login, /password/reset.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 2 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: The start page took 2392 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: The largest element paints after 5.1 s
fix.evidence: Measured once in Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) with no network throttling. A phone on mobile data will be slower.
fix.fix: Serve the hero image in a modern format at the shown size, preload it, and cut render-blocking scripts.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
